scope: One saved-corner necessary barrier for the actual mapped m1 control only; not a retry/continuation of its failed finite-table trajectory.
cases: Exactly original2grids x2material envelopes; same per-case qbar
prefix: Only contiguous finite upper<0 cells from.2V. Stop at first unknown/nonnegative cell. Intersect with old certified prefix; no new voltage nodes.
score: Reuse old certified_native_mask and optimistic_current_upper_a on the prefix intersection; sum max(log10(Iobs/Iceil),0)^2 and divide by original500. Other points contribute0 optimistically.
no_prefix_policy: If no positive-length prefix is certified, floor is null and no physical conclusion is drawn.
domain_scope: Necessary condition for an admissible continuous trajectory on the certified prefix; no behavior beyond the saved table or failed4.707V trajectory is invented.
comparisons: Existing m2 achieved conditional score and old sinh conditional score only; not new acceptance gates.
budget_start: After source/data/identity validation and plan saving, before four-case arithmetic.
stop_policy: Preserve failures; no new root, inverse, grid, seed, fit, model domain or retry.
